findings.title: Do not cache devices whose admission was rejected
findings.body: tagDeviceUI populates the 29-minute local cache before calling CreateOrUpdateDevice. When the limit is reached, a new device's first request returns ErrDeviceLimitReached, but its next request hits that cache and returns nil, allowing Anonymous.Authenticate to grant access. Concurrent requests can bypass the rejection the same way. Only cache a device after successful admission, and add a regression test that retries a rejected device.

findings.title: Make the device-limit check and admission atomic
findings.body: CountDevices and the subsequent upsert run in separate database sessions without serialization. With one slot remaining, two requests for different new devices can both observe a count below the limit and both insert successfully. Subsequent requests keep both devices admitted because the at-limit branch permits updates to existing rows. Serialize the count-and-admit operation across Grafana instances so concurrent arrivals cannot exceed the configured limit.

findings.title: Register device_limit for environment-variable overrides
findings.body: This reads the new option directly from the INI file without adding a device_limit entry to conf/defaults.ini. Grafana's environment-override pass operates on existing INI keys, so setting only GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_DEVICE_LIMIT in a standard deployment leaves this value at zero and silently keeps anonymous devices unlimited. Add the default configuration key or read it through the environment-aware settings accessor.

findings.title: Give the runtime device limit its numeric union type
findings.body: This initializer infers anonymousDeviceLimit as undefined; implementing GrafanaConfig does not inherit its number | undefined member type. The exported runtime config is a GrafanaBootConfig, so numeric assignments fail type checking and consumers that guard against undefined then format the limit encounter a never type, despite the backend supplying a number. Declare the field as number | undefined explicitly.
